description:
Use this when the user asks how an Indian stock's return compared with an index such as Nifty 50 over a period.

Returns the stock's price return beside the index's over the same window, with each side's annualised volatility, largest fall from a peak, and best and worst day, and the difference between the two returns in percentage points. `symbol` is the NSE symbol of a mainboard equity; SME stocks, funds and bonds are not covered. `index` is an NSE index name (default Nifty 50). The window is `days` (default 365, at most 1825), or `from_date` and `to_date`. Returns exclude dividends. The stock side uses NSE's adjusted previous close on corporate-action days (unit-tested, not checked on a real split). `days_without_row` counts stored days the stock has no row.

index.description: NSE index name, e.g. "Nifty 50" or "Nifty Bank"; list_index_valuations gives the names.
index.title: Index

name: get_stock_vs_index
title: Stock against an index
